import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_31/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_31/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_31/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

    # Inspect columns:
    # df0: ['State', 'Participation', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math', 'Total']
    # df1: ['State', 'Participation', 'English', 'Math', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']

    # Rename columns in df0 to match target suffix _x for Participation and Math
    df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
        'Participation': 'Participation_x',
        'Math': 'Math_x'
    })

    # Rename columns in df1 to match target suffix _y for Participation and Math
    df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
        'Participation': 'Participation_y',
        'Math': 'Math_y'
    })

    # Merge on 'State' (inner join to keep only states present in both)
    merged = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='State', how='inner')

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['State': string,
    #  'Participation_x': string,
    #  'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer,
    #  'Math_x': integer,
    #  'Total': integer,
    #  'Participation_y': string,
    #  'English': float,
    #  'Math_y': float,
    #  'Reading': float,
    #  'Science': float,
    #  'Composite': float]

    # Ensure correct dtypes:
    # Participation_x and Participation_y are strings (percentages with % sign)
    # Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math_x, Total are integers
    # English, Math_y, Reading, Science, Composite are floats

    # Convert numeric columns in df0
    merged['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing'] = merged['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing'].astype(int)
    merged['Math_x'] = merged['Math_x'].astype(int)
    merged['Total'] = merged['Total'].astype(int)

    # Convert numeric columns in df1
    merged['English'] = merged['English'].astype(float)
    merged['Math_y'] = merged['Math_y'].astype(float)
    merged['Reading'] = merged['Reading'].astype(float)
    merged['Science'] = merged['Science'].astype(float)
    merged['Composite'] = merged['Composite'].astype(float)

    # Select columns in target order
    target_columns = [
        'State',
        'Participation_x',
        'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing',
        'Math_x',
        'Total',
        'Participation_y',
        'English',
        'Math_y',
        'Reading',
        'Science',
        'Composite'
    ]

    target_df = merged[target_columns]

    # Save to CSV
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
